notes.title: Universe Exploration patch soon
notes.notes: [p]Probably the largest patch since the graphics overhaul is reaching its testing phase soon so I just wanted to post here to let people know progress is still happening. [/p][p]Brand new universe exploration UI with a much more modern feel should make the game feel more approachable to new players,  there will also be fuel cost for travel as well as randomly generated events while traveling that could be anything from traveling merchants to combat encounters in your vessel and much more.  Solar systems will accurately depict what types of planets are in them from the universe map while planets actively rotate around different types of suns (some of which have effects on the levels in the solar system).  The player can now also see what missions are available in what systems and make travel choices based on that, though the missions also have time limits before resetting as well meaning you have to choose which rewards you really want.  [/p][p]Overall I'm really happy with the progress on this and I do feel this is the patch that is making the game start to feel like a full game as I originally intended it.  I'm hoping to release by the end of August but it could easily drag into September. [/p][p]The patch after this one will largely focus on better level generation and increased multiplayer stability and quality of life, the penciled in goal for that patch is mid December but that is still a bit up in the air.[/p][p]As always thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: Ophioc Ship Patch
notes.notes:
This patch is primarily adding a tile set called Ophioc Ship, it houses a few new enemies and a few old ones from the Ophioc faction.  There are some new hidden mechanics on the level as well that I won't list here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/f2594fd8bfecf9f833db9526c165ef28cadcd269.png[/img]

Here is a screenshot of the new level alongside a few of the new enemies.  

On another note, this patch took a lot longer than I expected it to.  I am also starting a new job next week which I'm very excited for but will most likely reduce the time I have to spend working on Dead Metal.  But don't worry I'm hardly done working, just trying to set low expectations for the timing of the next patch.  

Speaking of the next patch, finally finally finally getting the new wave defense mode into the game.  It would have made it into this patch but I keep finding bugs with it.  I think it would be best to focus on it for its own patch as opposed to releasing it alongside the tile set.  I am hoping to have that patch out by the end of April as the content is mostly done and its mainly bugfixes remaining.  

Post that is going to be some of the largest patches the game will see and there will be months between them.  These patches are aiming for a few things, the first of which is making the gameplay loop feel cleaner and more eventful.  I will be reducing the size of the explorable galaxy while increasing the variety of things that can spawn within it which should cause players to find cool parts of the universe way faster.   I've loosely scheduled this patch for August as it will be completely redoing a lot of random universe generation and adding a ton of random events for players to encounter both in levels and while using the new space travel system... also there will be a new space travel system.  

The next major patch I'm aiming for late November and it will be the revamped level generation patch.  Making more interesting levels that make some contextual sense as to what they are will be the goal here.  So if you raid a space pirate ship that ship will reasonably have a bridge, an engine room, cafeteria, ect ect.  I  also want missions to reflect this new more intelligent level design, missions to steal data for the server room of a building, or sabotage various parts of a massive ship.  A lot of the ideas for this patch are not concrete but I do know that the current level generation isn't meeting what I want for the game.

That's all for now, as always thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Skirmish level type and new boss
notes.notes:
The patch todays main feature is a new gamemode called skirmish, this plays out much more like a standard turned based strategy game level where there are a set amount of enemies in a room and you have to kill them all to get out.  These levels can currently spawn on most any planet or ship that generates and should be relatively easy to find though they are a bit rarer than the normal exploration missions types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/e592fabd2ac25fbcea4a4e32d1a77147988b2dcd.png[/img]

These levels can spawn quite barren as well as with a variety of cover and enemies, it is fairly random how difficult they are though I haven't found it to be unfair in my own testing.  Very happy to hear feedback about difficulty though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/879e6991a32a84103042c871b37d3d348000ab50.png[/img]

I wont include any of the new bosses screenshots or how to find the boss as I like to have some mystery waiting for players to discover, but its a low/mid tier boss that should be relatively easy to accidentally bump into on a playthrough.  

Various mostly MP related bugs were fixed in this patch as well, there is still a bug I'm looking to hotfix where if you click single player before hosting a multiplayer match you wont be able to launch a MP game until you restart the game.  This will be fixed by tomorrow or Sunday at the latest. 

As for the future, I intend to have a patch out either late Dec or early Jan with another new tileset out as its been awhile since the snow level and some more variety is always nice.  Right now Im intending to be an Ophioc focused map with a 3 new ophioc units that only (for now at least) spawn specifically on the new tileset.  Once that is out I plan to spend about month on a wave defense mode in order to help people farm ore faster, I know this was promised earlier but I seem to keep putting it on the back burner. 

Once again thank you all for playing, report any bugs either on discord or in the steam discussion section.  If I dont respond fast enough feel free to DM/ping me on discord.  (which you can find a link to the discord in game)

notes.title: Graphics Update Finally Arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, its finally here.  After a solid 4 months of work basically every single piece of art has been redone and it looks a lot better. A lot of bugs have been fixed as well but I was so focused on art that I don't have a great change log for that. Instead I will just post some examples of the new art below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/b13937ff46e3cbaefe207e517bb86e31ca71925e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/9cbd8480f0831ec1d26b8778b7dcc148d208197a.png[/img]

As you can see these are some pretty huge upgrades from the prior art and the steam page has been adjusted to show it off as well.  I will be paying very close attention for any bugs caused by this patch as a lot of assets were deleted and replaced, I have successfully played through the game with all bosses cleared once but I intend to do it again to make sure there wasn't anything huge missed.  

Work will begin almost immediately on a new tileset and a wave defense mission type, the next patch will most likely be in November sometime including all of the above plus a boss or two.  

As always thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update on graphics improvement patch
notes.notes:
Hello, I know I said there would be an intermediate patch with about half the new graphics but the new graphics combined with the old ones look.... silly.  So I'm burning through all of it and hoping to be done by August 20th.  Progress is still going well and part of the delay is coming in the form of scope creep, for instance now we have shadows rendered under most units and objects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/da2abe357d14837a6a5c6471d4db77853bf7e018.png[/img]

This is a WIP preview of the new art with shadows included, right now all the player character art is done as well as half the tile sets and 4/5 of the units. While it might be a little later than Aug 20th this will be the largest patch yet in terms of effort put in. After that its back to content content content as Im going to be adding a new mission type as well as another tile set before the end of the year.  A few bosses should be making their way in as well. 

That's it for now, just letting it be known work is still continuing!

notes.title: Graphics Overhaul
notes.notes:
As was teased at in the last update, the next patch has a rather large graphics overhaul for the in level graphics.  This includes new unit models new enemy models and new tile sets for all the levels.  Right now I have just finished all the character models and am moving on to redoing some of the less sightly (made earlier in the development process) enemies.  I'm hoping to patch about half the new graphics in about a month and then do the other half a month after that.  

As far as new content goes the second of the two matches will be including a new wave defense mission type which will have a snow variant and a abandoned vessel variant.  This will feature a few new enemy types as well.  Once the art overhaul is done adding the 5th tileset/ 7th boss fight in will be the priority though that's too far out to give a reasonable time frame.

That's all for now, just wanted to keep people updated and let it be known that work is still being done at a solid pace.  As always feel free to join the discord and report and bugs you might find.  

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Added Tech Items
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/3656abfdd909a280b0b141ef5655a1bf8c97a5b8.png[/img]

Patch Notes

-Tech items now added and can drop from appropriate mobs
-When you equip a tech item you gain a 5th ability on your equipped suit
-Currently 10 tech items in the game though more will be added over time
-Tech items only drop on lv 3 or higher maps (with a few exceptions)


Today I'm happy to announce that tech items are in the game, items which give you a 5th ability per character when equipped meant for further customization.  A few minor bugs were also squashed as well:

-Crash when certain items were used on a certain boss fight
-Limited per mission use abilities now correctly display "Out Of Charges" pop up when you are out of charges for the mission. 

Post this I'm going to start work on a new tileset and a new set of mobs for that tileset.  The new tileset will be for mining posts on a new type of planet which is currently just being called "Ice Planet".  Along with the new tileset there will be a new mission type as well, ore extraction.  The player will defend against waves of monsters to buy time by ore to refine into upgrade metals, this will hopefully remedy the grind to upgrade your suits.  These wave by wave missions will have a new set of mobs that can spawn on them but they can also randomly decide that space pirates or ophioc swarms are guarding this particular mining outpost.  I'm hoping this will be done by late February though I think it may be more realistic to expect it in early/mid March.  

As always thanks for playing! Ill provide another update before the release of the next patch to give further details on the new type of mission.

notes.title: Star System/Galaxy screen overhaul
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/3656abfdd909a280b0b141ef5655a1bf8c97a5b8.png[/img]

  As I said in the last patch notes my least favorite piece of the UI was the map enter screen better known as the navigation tab.  The UI art for it was lacking and it didn't add any depth of gameplay other than to try to convince the user that at some point real and meaningful universe generation might be on its way.  And while I can't yet say that the universe generation is anywhere close to what I want yet, this is the start of bringing it towards that point.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/5671c23874ea6b36a317f160077e9a8797e913a4.png[/img]

This is what I've been working on for the last few weeks since the last patch and while I don't think its a final version of how it will work I do much prefer the art and now the universe generation will name star systems and will generate permanent planets.  These planets will eventually matter a lot more (and there are only 3 types of planets at the moment) as only certain levels will spawn on certain planets, I just don't feel the variety of level is quite in to meaningfully have 10-15 different kinds of planets though that is the eventual goal.   I intend to add planets into the game as I make levels that can only spawn on those types, this will include special levels with different styles of maps like wave defense maps and resource gathering maps.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/7d4616918d943b08df9f588ce1e8d04bfdeb242d.png[/img]

The galaxy overview map as seen above will be seeing some changes in the future as well, eventually the type of star in the system center (or black hole/ other large mass) will be part of determining bonus effects in levels ran in that system.  But this is still a far away addition unfortunately as going forward its finally time to focus on making new tile sets and enemies to start to populate the galaxy and give purpose to the new planets.  

------PATCH NOTES------
-Planets now permanently spawn in solar systems
-New art for solar system map
-New art for galaxy map
-Ophioc cave levels can only spawn on planets
-New UI for level selection

I'm hoping to get one more patch out before December ends  and it will largely be a multiplayer stability patch as I will be busy with holiday stuff until the new year so I don't want to commit to a huge new tile set just yet.  I'm hoping for the first of many new tile sets (level type)  to be available early February.  

As always thanks for playing!

notes.title: Quests and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Quests are finally in the game and they seem to be working well from the testing Ive done, you will now have a main quest that will generally tell you how to progress in the game as well as 2 side quest slots you can obtain from talking to NPCs in the station. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/de6ddcc2205b6444d355e5569711c693a309aa61.png[/img]

The screenshot above is an example of one of said NPCs.  More of these will be added over time of course along with more quests and content.  These quests will also aid players in finding hidden side bosses that have yet to be found by anyone. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/577ae1fc989dbc7bd508d45ac3b923f9d45565b5.png[/img]

Right now there are three new NPCs to talk to as well as the Kale the merchant on this NPC page, you will have to come through this screen to buy and sell items.  There are plans for more merchants with different kind of items for sale in the future as well.  

PATCH NOTES
-3 new NPC quest givers have been added to the game 
-Main quest has been added to the game
-A total of 10 side quests and 3 main quests in game
-Quest log has been added to the game
-Bug with tutorial highlights being frozen fixed
-Bug with items overwriting each others icons (not effecting the items themselves) fixed
-Tutorial screen placement wont get in the way anymore
-Many other small bug fixes not worth mentioning 


Next on the docket is a complete redo of the universe map screen:

1) It looks terrible compared to other parts of the UI 
2) I no longer like the way exploration works and the size of the universe will be scaled down a fair bit to allow for more obvious progression
3) Finding hidden stuff in the game as meant to be hard but not as hard as it is currently, steps will be taken to remedy that (though I still will keep some things as hard to find as they are now)

After that screen is done being reworked I will move on to making more tile sets for new levels which is something I've been looking forward to doing for quite some time now.  I may decide to add trinkets/tech items (not sure what exactly they will be called) that will be used to add trinket/tech item specific abilities onto your bar increasing the max number of abilities to 5 or 6 per character.  This will include the 4 decided by weapon and then 1 or 2 added from different tech items.

That's all for now!  You can expect the rework of the Universe Map to be done by mid December and either tech items or a new tile set by mid January.  I've decided to do patches on a monthly(ish) cycle as thats about how long it takes me to add a major feature, though things like a new tile set will probably be a 2 month project as it will come with all new mobs and at least 1 story boss and 1 hidden extra boss.

notes.title: Level Generation and Party Follow
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/3656abfdd909a280b0b141ef5655a1bf8c97a5b8.png[/img]

Ive been spending some time trying to figure out how to reduce movement woes between rooms when you have to control all 4 party members in single player.  I have two solutions that will hopefully work together to resolve this issue.  

-A large portion of level generation was rewritten to cause much much shorter distance between rooms

-You could press X to call your party to you already but now its in much much better working order and (hopefully) less plagued with bugs.  

I'm hoping that solves it for now, more changes (like a lot more) will be coming to level generation over time but I think this will resolve my primary issue with levels at the moment.  

More changes coming soon and as always thanks for playing!

notes.title: MP Usability Update 1
notes.notes:
The last patch fixed a lot of issues with the normal game UI (outside of levels) and this patch is mainly another UI focused one.  The multiplayer interface to get into a lobby can be confusing and buggy, this patch as well as another one coming this weekend are seeking to fix that.  

-You will now be prompted upon launching the game to create a user name for multiplayer, this username will appear when you join a match lobby now so you can see who is in your lobby and in which slot. 

-You can change above mentioned username from the multiplayer screen, you will find a new button on the bottom right of that screen.

-Fixed bug caused when the AI Boss was killed
-Fixed issue with game loading other saves bots in strange conditions
-Fixed issue causing the new UI screen to go blank when no abilities are selected on your bots
-Fixed issue with multiplayer just giving you the tutorial level on space pirate levels over and over

Thats it for now, more multiplayer UI stuff coming this weekend as well as a good amount of multiplayer gameplay bug fixes.  

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: UI Redo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/3656abfdd909a280b0b141ef5655a1bf8c97a5b8.png[/img]

So the majority of the negative feedback I've gotten has to do with the UI...

And I agree, it needed work.  This update fixes a lot of those issues but not all of them quite yet.  The multiplayer lobby host/join system is still in need of an update but the in game UI and starting tutorial is far easier to use/navigate with this update.  The Inventory / Stat screen got a 100% rework as well as the days of walking around the station to reach different UI pages is gone.  Its all navigated from a (hopefully) easy to use computer monitor that both looks nicer and feels much more intuitive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/88ec3b4e77ac11e1c296ad71002f0678e658a385.png[/img]


This is the a look at the new stat screen, all the other UI menus will be updated to this quality over the next week though they already have the same general layout with the different menu options on the bottom of the screen.  

Coming up next: 

1) First off as stated above my next project is the host/join in multiplayer.  Its going to get a full overhaul and be brought up to the easy to use standard which I'm modeling after other very popular multiplayer roguelike/lites.  

2) New art for planets/stations/systems on the universe map.

3) Some old art pieces in game that were made very early in development are being replaced.

4) Quest givers will be added to the station to give players more direction on what to do and even how to find hidden bosses if you do enough quests for them.

5) Weapon skill is going out the window as a way to unlock abilities, it will just be based on your stats (including armor additions) and the level of the suit. 

6) Trait system in which different events in missions can give semi permanent buffs/debuffs to your suits,  these will be able to be fixed in the repair shop along with an all new repair shop NPC to both provide quests and a little bit more lore while you repair your suits.  

7) Much much more but the above is what Im hoping to have done by mid/late October.  

As always let me know if you experience and difficulty in game with bugs or otherwise.  

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Balance changes and Network Fix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/3656abfdd909a280b0b141ef5655a1bf8c97a5b8.png[/img]

A few balance changes for the first major boss in the game mostly for 2 player and 3 player multiplayer modes as well as a fix for some computers with certain anti-virus software.

---Balance---
-Floating spider adds health has been reduced by 50% if two players are present and 25% if 3 players are present, the health pool way far too large for players to fight the adds off properly while still dealing damage to the boss without a full squad of four.

---Bugfix---
-Constant reloading bug with certain anti-virus software fix, the game can no longer register failures to connect to the multiplayer service from the main page

That's all for now, there still seems to be some issues requiring people in multiplayer to all restart the game on occasion if one person crashes in order to re-host with proper values for their characters.  I'm still looking into this and have made some changes that may combat this but I'm not totally convinced this is wrapped up hence its not in the bugfix section.  I will of course make further changes if need be.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Dead Metal Early Access Launch
notes.notes:
Today is the first day of Dead Metal early access, over time many many many new features, enemies, bosses and more will be added.  I am very excited to get the game out into the public space and am looking forward to feedback from early access players in order to make the game the best it can be.  

There will be regular bug fix patches over the next few weeks for whatever is discovered during this very early period in the games life.  If you come across any bugs you should feel welcome to come join the games public discord which is linked both on the steam main page and in game.  

I hope you all have as much fun playing as I had and will continue to have working on it.
